H("Count I — Breach of the Exclusive Distribution Agreement ($7,850,800)", 2)
P("**Apex’s theory.** (a) Both non-renewal notices were void under § 4.2, so the Agreement renewed through Feb. 28, 2026, and Greenfield repudiated it; (b) Greenfield made $4.26M in direct sales in the Territory; (c) Greenfield refused to honor the Renewal Term. Damages: $7,084,000 renewal-term lost profits ($16.1M projected annual purchases × 22% gross margin × 2 years) plus $766,800 lost “commissions” (18% × $4.26M). Also seeks § 14.2 fees and specific performance.")
P("**Elements (Georgia law per § 16.1):** a valid contract, breach, and resulting damages. Validity is not in dispute.")
P("**Assessment — liability: high risk for Greenfield.**")
B("**Signatory defect (July 15 notice).** Section 4.2’s text is specific and contains its own voidness consequence. Georgia courts generally enforce unambiguous contractual notice conditions as written, and the express “void” language defeats substantial-compliance and “no prejudice/actual notice” arguments. Possible but weak counter-arguments: (i) the clause says “delivered by,” and the letter was cc’d to the CEO and GC; (ii) the purpose (senior-level authorization) was satisfied if Ellsworth in fact approved the non-renewal decision before July 15 — **we need the facts on whether Ellsworth authorized Hargrove** (Ms. Yuen says the letter was sent without her approval but does not say whether the CEO approved it); (iii) ratification by the CEO before Aug. 31. Each is undercut by Apex’s prompt objection, Greenfield’s silence, and the Sept. 12 letter’s statement that it “supersedes and replaces” the July notice (which implicitly concedes the first notice’s inadequacy).")
B("**Timing defect (Sept. 12 notice).** Our computation: Sept. 12, 2023 → Feb. 28, 2024 = 169 days; the 180-day cut-off was Sept. 1, 2023 (Aug. 31 yields 181 days). Delivery by FedEx could make receipt Sept. 13 (168 days). Unless the omitted notice clause deems notice effective on some earlier event (unlikely), the notice is untimely.
